checks.label: Site URL
checks.help: Set SITE_URL in src/config/site.ts to the live domain, with https://.

checks.label: Tagline
checks.help: Set SITE_TAGLINE in src/config/site.ts. It is used in the homepage title, footer, RSS and llms.txt.

checks.label: Brand profiles (sameAs)
checks.help: List the brand's official profiles (LinkedIn company page, Crunchbase, X) in SAME_AS.

checks.label: Google Analytics ID
checks.help: Set GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID in src/config/site.ts, or PUBLIC_ANALYTICS_ID in Vercel (not visible to this check).

checks.label: Articles index description
placeholders: Browse every published article: practical guides on technical SEO, content strategy and the operating systems behind them, kept current and reviewed.
checks.help: Still the template's text about SEO. Rewrite ARTICLES_DESCRIPTION for this site's subject (140–160 characters).

checks.label: Team index description
placeholders: Meet the people behind this site: the operators and editors who write, review and maintain every guide, and the experience each one brings to the work.
checks.help: Still the template's text. Rewrite TEAM_DESCRIPTION if it does not fit (140–160 characters).

checks.label: Wordmark
checks.help: The header still reads "Site Name". Generate the design guide in TNV → Design, or set brand.wordmarkPrimary / wordmarkAccent in site/Design Guide.md.

checks.label: Logo, favicon, social image and demo images
checks.help: These files are byte-for-byte the template's own. Replace logo.png (raster, at least 112×112), favicon.svg and og-default.png (1200×675), and the demo article and author images.

checks.label: Page images
checks.help: Each hero slide and feature split shows a text brief until it has a src. Save the image in src/assets/ and add src: next to the brief.

checks.label: Page copy
checks.help: Replace the template copy, meta titles and descriptions, and the hello@example.com address in every page YAML. Resolve every [GAP: …] line.

checks.label: Homepage template sections
checks.help: The homepage still has sections that describe the template itself (stats, rich text, the sample page header). Rewrite them or remove them.

checks.label: Privacy policy
checks.help: Replace with a reviewed privacy policy. Once the placeholder is gone, confirm someone reviewed it.

checks.label: Terms of use
checks.help: Replace with reviewed terms. Once the placeholder is gone, confirm someone reviewed them.

checks.label: Testimonials
checks.help: Replace every quote with a real, cleared testimonial, or delete the Testimonials page and the homepage block. Confirm the quotes are real.

checks.label: Author profile
checks.help: Fill in the author's name, role, bio and photo in src/content/team/.

checks.label: Author file name
checks.help: Rename site-author.md to the author's slug (e.g. jane-doe.md) and update author in every article.

checks.label: Services
markers: Replace this page at Site Activation
checks.help: Replace the template service with the site's real offers in src/content/services/.

checks.label: Demo articles
checks.help: Delete the four SEO demo articles (and their images) once the site's own articles are published.
